name: Iwai Kenji
source:
Former head investigator of the Iwai Detective Agency. During a case, he met the protagonist and Tomona. He was working to uncover a behind the scenes conspiracy involving the government and police force. Amidst this investigation, he was wrongly framed as a terrorist and convicted. He is currently serving time in prison.

[From [url=https://tokyo-psychodemic.com/?lang=en]Official Website[/url]]
